records.observation: Static event renderer; empty constructor only Object. Initial Base_Half_Width=6 but Base_Width=3 (inconsistent until setter); setBaseWidth computes integer width/2, clamps negative half to0 and doubles, rounding positive odd widths down. Tolerance setter squares int then adds1 before double conversion (unchecked overflow), default squared threshold10. draw converts time x, checks DrawnBox.coversEvent, then records x BEFORE viewport rejection. Only strict 0<x<imageWidth draws, so x0/width boundaries excluded. Converts three row coordinates y1/y2/y3, draws colored vertical y1-to-y3, fills oval at x-half,y2,width,y1-y2-1 when y2!=y1. Oval temporary x/height remain0 if y2==y1, yet white outline branch still uses them when y1!=y3; otherwise white horizontal cap x+-half at y2. No row-order/positive-size checks. Optional stroke saved/restored only normal path, color left white, no finally. containsPixel computes squared distance to converted vertical segment and strictly compares threshold, not oval/cap geometry; no DrawnBox or viewport check. Static parameters shared across callers; no raster execution performed.

records.observation: Static line renderer, constructor only Object. Tolerance int square+1 unchecked then double, default10; containsPixel compares Line2D.ptSegDistSq of original converted endpoints strictly below threshold, independent of stroke width, clipping and DrawnBox. Public draw orders endpoint pairs by time (equal/NaN comparison falls to swapped branch) then drawForward converts x and tests coversArrow; records full endpoint x range before clipping or early-return. xleft>0 and xright<imageWidth flags, slope computed from int differences converted to double if either fails; equal x then return0. Left endpoint clips/extrapolates to0, right to imageWidth (not width-1), y uses Math.rint. No explicit rejection for entire segment outside viewport, no y clipping or finite checks; final Graphics clipping is external. Int coordinate subtraction can overflow. Sets supplied color, optional stroke saved/restored only on normal path, draws once then returns1 even if graphics clip hides all pixels. Does not restore color; no numerical/model data changes.

records.observation: Static rectangle renderer; default border WHITE_RAISED_BORDER, setter stores any reference including null without validation; border implementations separately unread. draw and containsPixel independently order times and rows with comparisons (not endpoint-pair ordering). drawForward converts coordinates and uses DrawnBox.coversState/set BEFORE Insets and viewport clipping. Optional Insets add left/top and subtract right/bottom unchecked; no prevention of inverted rectangle. Flags left>=0 and right<imageWidth; left clipped only to0, right only towidth-1, no fully-outside or vertical rejection. fillRect inclusive extents right-left+1,bottom-top+1 then delegates paintStateBorder with endpoint-valid flags, returns1; thus return1 is attempted draw, not proof of visible pixels. No color restore; null border fails after fill. containsPixel uses unmodified converted original rectangular bounds, inclusive on four edges, without Insets, viewport, DrawnBox or border geometry; therefore inset display and selectable region can differ. Pixel monotonicity supplied by CoordPixelXform is assumed after ordering original coordinates. No archived application or GUI executed.
